Amazon and Walmart are two of the most profitable companies in the country — generating $100 billion in profits last year according to Popular Information — but many of their workers still qualify for Medicaid because their pay is near (or below) the poverty line. item.title: GovBrief Today #542
item.description: The Pentagon told Congress that the war it has been fighting since February started three weeks ago. That bought another 60 days of fighting before anyone in Congress can stop it. The books got adjusted this weekend. A second file opened in the casualty record, the dead and wounded were split between two wars that are actually one war, and a count that said 482 Americans hurt since February now adds up to at least 624. Nearly a hundred troops were wounded after the shooting started again, and the Pentagon says those were mostly minor concussions. Six years ago, Iranian missiles injured more than a hundred troops, and Trump said they had headaches and were not seriously hurt. The Army denied their Purple Hearts while he was president. They were honored after he was gone. I've emailed 8,392 stories over 542 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. item.title: Hadestown review for Redhead Monday!
item.description:
Hello all. On July 24th I had a life changing experience. I saw the Hadestown proshot in theaters!
I dressed as Eurydice from the New York theatre workshop production and nobody recognized me! I was a little surprised because it was opening night but maybe it’s just not a recognizable enough costume?
Idk but I LOVE Nabiyah Be’s voice she’s incredible.
I thrifted my costume so I worked with what I had lol. I made my boyfriend take my picture with this poster because I couldn’t believe this was the one they chose to go with! I’d seen it on Reddit and thought it was a joke! Imagine my surprise
We went with 2 of my wonderful beautiful friends who I love so much. Neither of them had any idea what it was about going in and they both loved it! I get so excited when I can show people somwthing that I love more than anything and they love it too (everybody go watch Superman!!)
I was going to go twice to see it so I made Eurydice’s costume from the Broadway production too but going to the movie theatre costs money and literally the day after we went and saw the odyssey so I’ll have to wear that costume another day
I made a moodboard to convince you guys to watch it
I was high when I wrote this can’t you tell? The top part is supposed to say “cried” btw. I WEPT throughout all of “why we build the wall” as well it’s so fucking GOOD!!!! I LOVE MUSICALS SO MUCH!! After I got done crying over that song, I whispered to everybody that that song was written in 2006. Anaïs Mitchell the woman you are.
We debrief after every movie and I’m so happy Chris liked it. During “they danced” I asked him if we could play it at our wedding and he said “yeah why not, people play Benson Boone at weddings” LMFAO
PLEASE MAKE MORE PROSHOTS!!! I still need to finish my essay on how I got into musicals but it all started with a proshot!
Trudy bear is my unwilling accomplice in my favorite outfits
But she’s low-key mogging me here I love her so much.
THE LIGHTING?!?!
The wait for me reprise is my ringtone! GUYS GO WATCH HADESTOWN!!! It’s in theaters for 5 days only!!
It’s about Greek mythology and love and revolution!
Thank you for letting me yell about musicals again, Imgur!
